transport.input: one JSON object on stdin except for capabilities, doctor, and self-test
transport.output: one strict JSON object on stdout; generic property-list syntax, duplicate keys, non-finite numbers, and trailing values are rejected

identity.caveat: The bundle identifier is stable, but an ad-hoc rebuild may cause macOS TCC to require authorization again. Run doctor after rebuilds.

read_only_contract.only_non_data_side_effect: authorize may display a macOS full-access prompt after confirmed=true
read_only_contract.explicit_scope: Every item query requires 1-50 selected Calendar or Reminder list IDs, a half-open RFC 3339 window, and a 1-500 result limit.

string_and_output_limits.behavior: Reject an oversized field without echoing it; reject the entire envelope if serialized output plus its newline would exceed 4 MiB.

doctor.note: Reads bundle, OS, and authorization status only; it does not instantiate an EventKit store or enumerate data.

self-test.note: Runs pure parser, time-window, command-surface, and privacy allowlist checks.

authorize.side_effect: May change only the macOS TCC permission state. Refuses to prompt unless confirmed is true.

input.source_id: optional non-empty source ID or null

window.end_at: exclusive RFC 3339 timestamp with offset; at most 62 days after start_at

events list.busy_semantics: Returns non-cancelled, non-free events without titles.
events list.summary_semantics: Returns all matching events, including cancelled/free items, and adds title plus creation/modification timestamps.

window.end_at: exclusive RFC 3339 timestamp with offset; at most 62 days after start_at

selection_semantics.incomplete_due_in_window: EventKit-bounded query for incomplete reminders by due date.
